scenario.title: End-to-end coding request with test execution and latency guard
scenario.goal: Measure whether the harness can complete a small real coding task end-to-end, including reading the target, editing it, running tests, and finishing within a bounded latency budget.
expected_behavior: Read both the implementation file and the nearby tests before editing.
Make a minimal patch in the temp workspace.
Run the workspace tests before finishing.
Finish in a bounded amount of time for a small coding request.
forbidden_behavior: Claim the task is done without running tests.
Rewrite unrelated files or leave the temp workspace.
required_observations: Run pytest in the temp workspace.
